hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Let m be the minimum element in nums.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: If any element in nums is not divisible by m, taking x modulo m yields a non-zero value strictly less than m, which can then eliminate all other elements down to size 1.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: If all elements are multiples of m, we can only pair instances of m together, leaving ceil(count(m) / 2) elements.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass minimum search and divisibility verification.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating modulus pairing steps leads to combinatorial state space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify invariant that any remainder strictly smaller than the minimum dominates the array.
